matchup.plan_md:
**The question:** pick up Quentin Grimes today, with Austin Reaves out?

**Research:**
- **Austin Reaves** is out Fri with a left heel bruise, and Grimes is expected to stay in the starting lineup ([RotoWire, 19 Nov](https://www.rotowire.com/basketball/headlines/austin-reaves-injury-still-out-friday-540088)). No timetable reported beyond Friday; *ESPN est.* 23 Nov.
- **Trey Murphy III** is still questionable as of the 4:45 PM ET report ([NBA injury report](https://ak-static.cms.nba.com/referee/injury/Injury-Report_2026-11-20_04_45PM.pdf)). No timetable reported beyond "a chance to return Friday"; *ESPN est.* 20 Nov.
- **The Lakers play only Friday** this weekend: SAC @ LAL, 10:00 PM ET (2:00 PM Sat Melbourne).

**The plans scored** (our lineup over 20–22 Nov; they score 701; adds: 4 of 7 used, **3 left**):

| Scenario | Moves | Lineup | Final |
|---|---|---:|---|
| **Murphy confirmed playing** | Gobert → Murphy (Fri); Bey → Queta, Missi → Mara (Sun) | **909.6** (846 + 63.6) | about 1,810 to 1,575 |
| **Murphy out or undecided: Grimes** | Gobert → Grimes (Fri); Grimes → Queta (Sat); Missi → Mara (Sun) | **901.5** (806 + 95.5) | about 1,802 to 1,575 |
| Murphy out or undecided: Mara | Gobert → Mara (Fri); Mara → Queta (Sat); Missi → Washington (Sun) | 900.0 (839 + 61.0) | about 1,800 to 1,575 |
| Grimes and Murphy | Missi → Grimes, Gobert → Murphy (Fri); Grimes → Queta (Sat) | 884.8 (821 + 63.8) | about 1,785 to 1,575 |

**Verdict:**
- **Murphy confirmed in by 10:55 AM Sat (Melbourne): Murphy.**
- **Otherwise: Grimes over Mara.** The script has Grimes 1.5 ahead at his role rate (36 min × his season FP per minute, ‡ 30.2). That role rate counts his bench games. As a starter he has scored 51.0 FP/g over 38 minutes, and at his plain rate (36.4) the Grimes route comes to about 907.
- **Not both.** Fitting Grimes next to Murphy drops Missi's Friday and Saturday games.
- **Plan line:** 2 adds.

**Times, Melbourne** (adds close at each US day's first tip-off):
1. **By 10:55 AM Sat 21** (adds close at 11:00 AM): drop **Gobert** and add **Murphy** if he is confirmed playing; otherwise add **Quentin Grimes**.
2. **Grimes route:** after SAC @ LAL ends (tip-off 2:00 PM Sat), drop Grimes and add **Neemias Queta**, before **5:00 AM Sun 22**.
3. **Sunday:** after NO @SA ends (tip-off 12:00 PM Sun 22), drop **Yves Missi** and add **Aday Mara**, before **7:30 AM Mon 23**.

**Form:**

| Player | Rate | Season | L7 | L15 | L30 | ESPN proj. |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Quentin Grimes | 30.2 ‡ (rate 36.4) | 24.0 (14) | 51.0 (3) | 36.2 (5) | 24.0 (14) | 28.1 |
| Trey Murphy III | 35.1 | 31.0 (9) | — | 38.5 (2), small sample | 31.0 (9) | 36.8 |
| Neemias Queta | 31.9 | 27.3 (14) | 38.0 (2), small sample | 29.3 (6) | 27.8 (13) | 27.2 |
| Aday Mara | 31.6 | 27.1 (15) | 34.3 (3) | 33.3 (7) | 28.0 (14) | — |

**Why the L7s are 5+ off the season:**
- **Grimes, +27.0:** starting with Reaves out, at 38.0 min against 28.6 for the season.
- **Queta, +10.7:** two games, a small sample.
- **Mara, +7.2:** about 25 min with Chet Holmgren out (*ESPN est.* 2 Jan).

- **Kel'el Ware:** his 19 Nov start was a one-off. Myles Turner is expected back Sat 21 Nov ([RotoWire, 19 Nov](https://www.rotowire.com/basketball/headlines/myles-turner-injury-sidelined-by-left-shoulder-contusion-540024)); *ESPN est.* 21 Nov.
